long long power(long long x, long long y, long long p) {
    if (y == 0) return 1;
    if (x == 0) return 0;

struct FastScanner {
    std::istringstream iss;
    std::string buffer;
    FastScanner() {}
    std::string next() {
        while (!(iss >> buffer)) {
            std::string line;
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
                return "";
            }
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return buffer;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return std::stoll(next());
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(next());
    }
    std::vector<int> readArray(int n) {
        std::vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = nextInt();
        return a;
    }
    std::vector<long long> readLongArray(int n) {
        std::vector<long long> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = nextLong();
        return a;
    }
};

void sieveOfEratosthenes(int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) prime[i] = true;
    for (int p = 2; p * p <= n; p++) {
        if (prime[p]) {
            for (int i = p * p; i <= n; i += p) prime[i] = false;
        }
    }
}

long long binomialCoeff(long long n, long long r) {
    if (r > n) return 0LL;
    long long m = 1000000007LL;
    std::vector<long long> inv(r + 1, 1);
    if (r + 1 >= 2) inv[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        inv[i] = m - (m / i) * inv[m % i] % m;
    }
    long long ans = 1LL;
    for (int i = 2; i <= r; i++) {
        ans = (ans * inv[i]) % m;
    }
    for (long long i = n; i >= n - r + 1; i--) {
        ans = (ans * (i % m)) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}
